title: Agents
subtitle: Give an agent a task and read what it did

empty.noConfiguredText: Create an agent to get started with autonomous AI workflows.
empty.browseHub: Don't know where to start? Browse the <1>Agent Hub</1> to find ready-made agent configurations you can import.

deleteDialog.title: Delete Agent
deleteDialog.message: Delete agent "{{name}}"? This action cannot be undone.

strip.label: Last {{count}} runs: {{done}} finished, {{failed}} failed
strip.none: No runs recorded in this browser

record.where: Runs are recorded in this browser while you watch them. The server keeps no run history, so another browser starts with an empty record.

agent.taskPlaceholder: Describe the task. For example: find two good sources on speculative decoding and summarise them.
agent.taskHint: Enter starts the run, Shift+Enter adds a line
agent.pausedNote: This agent is paused, so it cannot start a run.
agent.noRunsText: Describe a task above and press Start run. The run keeps its own address, and its report stays here.
agent.clearMessage: Remove the runs of "{{name}}" that this browser keeps, including chats the earlier agent chat page stored here? The agent and its server-side activity are not touched.
agent.missingText: It may have been deleted or renamed, or it belongs to another user.

run.statusTitle: Opens the agent's status in a new tab, so this run stays open
run.addressNote: This address opens in the browser that recorded the run. Another browser shows a notice, because the server keeps no run record.
run.noStepsReport: The agent answered without calling a tool.
run.reportWorking: The agent is still working on this.
run.cutOff: This run was cut off before the agent answered. The page that watched it was closed, or the connection dropped.
run.noAnswer: No answer was recorded for this run. The page was closed before the agent answered, or the answer did not arrive.
run.stoppedLine: Stopped before an answer was recorded
run.dockWorking: The agent is working. Follow-ups open when it answers.
run.reconnecting: Connection to the agent lost. Reconnecting.
run.followUpPlaceholder: Ask a follow-up, or add to this result
run.followUpPlaceholderStopped: Give it a new task, or ask about the last one
run.followUpHint: Enter sends, Shift+Enter adds a line
run.failText: The agent reported an error and did not finish the task. Running it again starts a new run with the same task.
run.failSendTitle: The task did not reach the agent
run.failSendText: The server did not accept the task, so the agent never started. Running it again sends it once more.
run.evidenceNote: What the tools returned to the agent during this run, as the agent received it.
run.missingTitle: This run is not in this browser
run.missingText: Run {{id}} is not in this browser's record. Runs are kept where they were started, and the server keeps no run history, so a link from another browser or a cleared record cannot be opened.

create.subCreate: Fill in what you need. Sections you leave alone keep their defaults.
create.subEdit: Runs in progress keep working on the version they started with.
create.previewNew: The configuration this form will save.
create.previewEdit: The configuration this form will save, and how it differs from the saved agent.
create.configNote: Values that look like keys, tokens or passwords are hidden here. They are saved as typed.
create.noChanges: No changes. The form matches the saved agent.
create.allNew: A new agent: every value you set is new.
create.draftLabel: Describe the agent in one sentence
create.draftPlaceholder: For example: an agent that reads my release notes and lists breaking changes
create.draftNote: Optional. Asks the model you chose to write a name, a description and instructions. Nothing is saved until you save, and the draft may be wrong, so read it first.
create.draftNeedsModel: Pick a model in the Model section first. The draft is written by that model.
create.draftBad: The model did not return a configuration
create.drafted: Draft added. Read it before you save.

status.title: Status
status.lede: What {{name}} did, one record per action. A run's report says what came of a task. This page is the raw record behind it.
status.emptyText: Give the agent a task and its actions show up here.
